mapper.update: UPDATE tickets SET status=#{status},assignee_id=#{assigneeId},version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.author_id,u.display_name author_name,c.body,c.internal,c.created_at FROM ticket_comments c JOIN users u ON u.id=c.author_id WHERE c.ticket_id=#{id} AND c.internal=FALSE ORDER BY c.id
